design_philosophy: Hinge-style editorial layout: high-contrast typography, large candid lifestyle photography, vast negative space, and clear, singular CTA focus.

typography.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#1C1917]
typography.label: text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#57534E]

spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-20 md:py-32 px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto

file_structure.recommendation: Use separate .web.js files for components to bypass React Native constraints and use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layout. Do not use Shadcn for this marketing page, use raw HTML/Tailwind.

icons.guidelines: No emojis. Keep icons sharp, monochrome, and structural.

sections_and_copy.name: Hero
sections_and_copy.layout: 2-column split. Left: Large typography (H1) + Subtext + Massive 'Get Started' button. Right: Full-height portrait-style lifestyle image with soft rounded corners. Image caps at max-h-[80vh] on mobile.

copy.label: THE SAFE STUDENT NETWORK
copy.headline: Designed to be deleted when you find your people.
copy.subheadline: DEQUAD is the only university-verified platform built for real connections, safeguarded by AI.

sections_and_copy.image_alt: Friends laughing and connecting over coffee

sections_and_copy.name: Mission
sections_and_copy.layout: Centered editorial block. Massive text taking up 70% of the screen width. Lots of negative space top and bottom. Optical alignment over geometric.

copy.headline: Built for students, by students. Not for random dating.
copy.body: University can be isolating. We built DEQUAD to help you find your actual peers—safely. No bots, no creeps, just verified students from your campus.

sections_and_copy.name: Features
sections_and_copy.layout: Asymmetrical Bento Grid (Tetris Grid). 4 Cards. Card 1 (Connect): col-span-12 md:col-span-8. Card 2 (Mood Tracking): col-span-12 md:col-span-4. Card 3 (AI Safeguarding): col-span-12 md:col-span-6. Card 4 (Support): col-span-12 md:col-span-6.

feature_1.title: Find your crowd.
feature_1.desc: Peer matching based on modules, societies, and real interests.

feature_2.title: Track your mind.
feature_2.desc: Daily mood check-ins designed to keep you grounded.

feature_3.title: AI Safeguarding.
feature_3.desc: Proactive crisis detection that keeps the community secure.

feature_4.title: 24/7 Support.
feature_4.desc: Real help when you need it, instantly.

sections_and_copy.name: Trust & Safety
sections_and_copy.layout: Split layout. Text on right, image on left. Minimalist icon list for key safety points. High negative space.

copy.label: VERIFIED & PROTECTED
copy.headline: A closed network for peace of mind.
bullets: AI moderation flags at-risk content instantly

sections_and_copy.image_alt: Student relaxed on campus, emphasizing safety

sections_and_copy.name: Testimonials
sections_and_copy.layout: 3-column grid. Pure typography quotes. Large serif quotation marks. No bounding boxes or cards, just text directly on the background.

quotes.text: Finally, an app where I can just meet people from my course without it feeling like Tinder.
quotes.author: Sarah, UoB

quotes.text: The mood tracking actually helps me realize when I'm burning out before exams.
quotes.author: James, LSE

quotes.text: Knowing everyone on here is a verified student makes it so much less daunting.
quotes.author: Priya, KCL

sections_and_copy.name: FAQ
sections_and_copy.layout: Clean accordion or simple list with sharp bottom borders separating items. Very readable, high contrast text.

questions.q: Do I need a university email?
questions.a: Yes. DEQUAD is strictly for verified UK university students.

sections_and_copy.name: Footer
sections_and_copy.layout: Massive bottom section. Dark background (#0F172A) to contrast the rest of the page. Huge text for CTA.

motion_and_interactions.entry: Elements should have a gentle cinematic fade up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) with a slow ease-out (duration: 0.8s) when scrolling into view.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons scale up slightly (scale: 1.02). Text color must remain accessible on hover. No extreme bouncing or spinning animations.

mobile_responsiveness.images: Images must cap at max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none to avoid dominating small screens.
mobile_responsiveness.typography: H1 scales fluidly but caps at text-6xl. Hierarchy gap must be maintained (H2 at text-4xl).
mobile_responsiveness.layout: All grids collapse to 1 column on mobile (grid-cols-1).

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='waitlist-submit', etc.
